[mcp_servers.alpha]
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "pkg", 3, 1.5, true]
enabled = false
[mcp_servers.alpha.env]
TOKEN = "sk-abcdefghijklmnop"
" PAD " = "x"
EMPTY = ""
NUM = 4
"" = "z"

[mcp_servers.n]
command = "c"
weight = 0xff
ratio = 1_0.5e+1
x = inf
y = nan
